payout_quote: As an affiliate referring a new participant who completes a study after signing up through your referral link, you'll be paid at least $15 per participant and currently up to $30 for 'high value' participants who are especially in demand. You'll also get a bonus for referring more than 100 participants each month. (Official User Interviews affiliates page, crawled 2026-09-23)
timing: Monthly: report of qualifying participants and commission within the first half of the following month; you invoice them and they pay
eligibility: Accepted into the User Interviews participant affiliate program (apply by emailing yahir@userinterviews.com); referred person must sign up through your link AND complete a study
steps: Apply to the User Interviews participant affiliate program by email
Get your unique referral link plus their social/video/newsletter promo tools
Share your link with people likely to qualify for and complete research studies
Each referred participant who completes a study earns you $15-$30
Receive the monthly report, submit your invoice, get paid
catches: The referred person must COMPLETE a study - signups alone earn nothing, and study screeners reject most applicants
You must be accepted into the affiliate program first - it's application-based, not automatic
You invoice them monthly and wait for payment - this is contractor-style payout, not instant
Strict rules: you must disclose the affiliate relationship, can't run paid ads, can't bid on their keywords, can't pose as their employee
High-value $30 rate applies only to in-demand participant profiles
biggest_catch: Signups earn you nothing - your referral must pass screeners and complete a full study, which most casual signups never do. And you have to apply and be accepted as an affiliate first.

Original: Official User Interviews affiliates page (userinterviews.com/user-interviews-affiliates, crawled 2026-09-23): at least $15 per participant, up to $30 for high-value, bonus over 100/month. Repeatable per qualifying referral.
maximize: Target your link at professionals with in-demand profiles (product managers, engineers, healthcare workers, marketers) - they're the ones who pass screeners and complete studies, and may hit the $30 high-value tier. Always include the disclosure ('As a User Interviews affiliate, I earn after you start participating through this link') - it's their rule, not optional. Coach your referrals to finish their profile completely before applying to studies; complete profiles get matched far faster, which is the difference between a signup and a $15-30 commission.
